subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

On the job
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3** (Working at a particular job)'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'On the job'** is an idiom that means engaged in work or while working.(कार्य करते समय)
 
• The phrase **'Working at a particular job'** best describes this idiom's meaning, referring to being engaged in a certain profession or task. (किसी विशेष नौकरी पर काम कर रहा है)

Therefore, the **correct answer **is-'*Working at a particular job'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1** 'In the war'(युद्ध में) doesn't express the meaning of the idiom.
 
• **Option 2 '**Avoiding the work', (काम से बचना) also doesn't express the meaning of the idiom.
 
• **Option 4** 'On the contrary',(उल्टा) does not fit the idiom's meaning either.
